wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap multipolygon includes the roof envelope and the open court. The park and one linked approach corroborate the mosque massing and its position above the south-facing public ground.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the main and half domes, all four minarets and the open courtyard arcade.
limitations: The 42 m central dome height, 27 m diameter, four 72 m minarets and their three balconies follow the documented 2012 proportions. The surrounding six half domes and upper mosque piers follow the architect’s description.

The outer mosque and open-court lines are mapped. Individual turret footings, dome seams, far-side façade motifs and courtyard trim are estimated. The unrelated Uphill Court apartments in the photograph belong to the normal Earth context.
The review uses the original terraced terrain for the exterior. The below-grade parking and service rooms and the interior are outside the model scope.
